scope: A fresh country-owned city question is reached through ordinary API messages, then an explicit compound pause or informational question must not enter a directory shortcut.

initial_attempt.cause: The author's controlled read-only adapter returned free text where READONLY_SCHEMA requires a section code. The new stub was corrected to geography; no production edit or relaxed business assertion was made by this agent.

verified: Initial input reaches owned AR place.city_query through API/Harness/real Store, with no fabricated city.
Compound input reaches user_pause and exactly one control revision.
Canonical facts remain equal apart from the control version.
The city request is deferred with the owned country reference.
No coordinator resolve/select, directory search/get, additional country lookup, TOOL_CALL_STARTED or order occurs for the compound pause.
Informational text takes the existing read-only model role using a controlled valid section-code response.
Trip, version, complete prior pending question and waiting reason remain equal.
No city or location reference is selected.
No coordinator/directory call, additional country lookup, TOOL_CALL_STARTED or order occurs.
An informational phrase without question punctuation does not become a city-query shortcut.
A controlled general ASK response is permitted; no assumption that it took the read-only role is made.
Trip, version, pending and waiting reason remain equal; no city/reference is selected.
No coordinator/directory call, additional country lookup, TOOL_CALL_STARTED or order occurs.

cache_hit_cannot_hide_a_false_pass: Spies cover coordinator.resolve/select and directory.search_city/get_place in addition to MockTransport wire counts. Bootstrap country resolve is observed then counters are cleared before the actual assertion.
limitations: These three cases use real persistent Store/API/Harness with controlled model/country/directory adapters, not new actual NLU or worldwide API qualification.
Other ASK/PROPOSE/cancel paths are covered by the parent's separate dynamic conversation tests and are not counted again here.
No full80/106, live availability, price, media, checkout, payment or booking qualification is implied.
